name: agent-globe
one_liner: A GPU-rendered 3D constellation of every coding-agent session, its subagents, and their terminal executions, live.

commands.release: cargo build --release && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/agent-globe | Out-Null; Copy-Item target/release/agent-globe.exe $env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/agent-globe/agent-globe.exe -Force"
